messages:
maria_g: Heads up — launching staged rollout for model-route v3 and enabling feature flag `fast_path_v2`. Ramp plan: 5% -> 25% (manual hold) -> 100%. Telemetry gating on errors, p95 latency, and eval-regression. Deploy bot will run toggles.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: deploy-20231114-001. Will follow flag ramp recipe attached by ops.

liam_t: quick Q — what are the hard rollback triggers this time? last week's oscillation still fresh.

maria_g: Hard rollback criteria: error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency > baseline +30% for 5m. Also any eval-set regression where golden-prompt mismatch rate > 2% over the snapshot. If any of these hit, we flip the flag to 0 and pin traffic back to route:v2@stable.

sophie_k: Please insert a telemetry snapshot after each step and prefer a manual hold before 100%. I'll own the signoff.

carla_r: Suggest a short manual hold at 25% so I can run quick smoke tests. Also pre-set the rollback pin: `route set model-route v2 --tag stable` so fallback is immediate.

maria_g: Ramp commands (deploy-bot will run these; keeping here for audit):
```bash
# start ramp
deploy-bot flag set fast_path_v2 --percent 5
# wait 20m for telemetry and sampling
# then to 25% (manual hold)
deploy-bot flag set fast_path_v2 --percent 25
# after signoff to 100%
deploy-bot flag set fast_path_v2 --percent 100
```

liam_t: +1 to manual hold. who signs off at 25%?

sophie_k: I'll sign off unless telemetry shows regressions. I'll run the eval harness and post results in-thread.

ops-oncall: Oncall is watching. I've added a short window of elevated monitoring and a pager rule for p95 spikes > baseline +25%. I'll suppress noisy low-severity alerts to avoid distraction.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 5% started at 2023-11-14T11:05:00Z. Telemetry snapshot generated: https://o11y.fake/telemetry/snap-5pct (placeholder).

maria_g: Release notes draft: "Enable `fast_path_v2` for model-route v3. Change window 11:00-12:00 UTC. 3-step staged rollout with telemetry gating. Rollback and pin to v2@stable described in rollback playbook." I'll push the PR to docs shortly.

sophie_k: Quick preflight checklist:
- smoke dashboards visible :eyes:
- run `make smoke` against canary endpoints
- run golden prompts set (10 samples) and diff
I'll post results within the hold window.

carla_r: Smoke at 25% looks good for my sample :thumbsup:. No obvious hallucination spike. Proceeding to signoff for 100% in ~12m.

liam_t: Added an explicit immediate unflag command in case of tokenization/regression: `deploy-bot flag set fast_path_v2 --percent 0` and `route set model-route v2 --tag stable`. Keep that ready.

maria_g: Thanks all — if anything odd appears ping @sophie_k, @carla_r, or @ops-oncall immediately. Will update thread with final status. :shipit:
